landing.tiersEyebrow: Two tiers, one decision made for you
landing.tiersTitle: Every case is routed to the right tier automatically.
landing.tier1Desc: Non-delivery, defective goods, refunds, service deficiency — resolved end-to-end as a documented settlement.
landing.tier2Desc: Loan recovery, contract breach, and §138 Negotiable Instruments Act matters — drafted by the agents, signed off by a licensed reviewer.
landing.agentsTitle: Five specialised agents, working in sequence.

agents.title: Ingestion
agents.desc: Parses filings & evidence, classifies the claim, routes to a tier.

agents.title: Precedent research
agents.desc: Semantic retrieval over forum decisions, keyword fallback where needed.

agents.title: Argument analysis
agents.desc: Weighs both sides' evidence strength against comparable outcomes.

agents.title: Mediation
agents.desc: Proposes a settlement both parties can accept before any order is drafted.

agents.title: Resolution drafting
agents.desc: Writes the order with findings, precedents relied upon, and next steps.

review.title: Preliminary review
review.subtitle: A quick, non-binding AI check of your evidence -- the real review happens after the respondent replies.

caseStrength.claimantAgentDetail: Reviewed your description and evidence for how they'd likely hold up.
caseStrength.respondentAgentDetail: Here's what the claimant has submitted so far, and whether it holds up.
caseStrength.authenticityCaveat: This only checks the document's text for obvious inconsistencies -- it can't detect a doctored image or an altered scan, and isn't a substitute for real verification.
